title: Qdrant Documentation - Distributed Deployment
snippet: Qdrant 单机即可承载千万级向量，分片集群用于横向扩展读写吞吐。
content: Qdrant supports sharding and replication. A single node handles up to tens of millions of vectors with HNSW; latency P99 stays under 10ms on commodity hardware. 演示摘录：单机千万级、P99<10ms。

title: Accelerating Milvus with NVIDIA CAGRA GPU Index
snippet: GPU 索引让亿级向量检索吞吐提升 10 倍量级。
content: Milvus 2.4 integrates NVIDIA CAGRA GPU index, achieving up to 10x throughput on billion-scale datasets vs CPU HNSW. 演示摘录：GPU 索引面向十亿级场景，小规模场景收益有限且需要 GPU 节点成本。

title: Qdrant vs Milvus for a 10M-vector RAG app?
snippet: 社区共识：千万级以下选 Qdrant 省心，需要分布式与 GPU 再上 Milvus。
content: Top comment: for under ~20M vectors a single Qdrant node is simpler to run; Milvus shines when you need horizontal scale, GPU index, or hybrid sparse-dense at billion scale. 演示摘录：规模阈值是主要分歧点。

title: Zilliz Cloud Pricing
snippet: 托管 Milvus 按存储与 CU 计费，起步价高于自托管。
content: Zilliz Cloud serverless starts at a computed CU rate; dedicated clusters bill per node-hour. 演示摘录：托管方便但溢价明显，自托管要承担 etcd/对象存储/消息队列的运维。

title: LangGraph Multi-Agent Concepts
snippet: Send API 支持 map-reduce 式动态并行派发子任务。
content: LangGraph Send API allows a node to dynamically fan out subgraph executions (map-reduce), each with its own state slice; results are merged via annotated reducers. 演示摘录：动态子 Agent 并行是一等公民。

title: We built our own agent orchestration - a postmortem
snippet: 团队一年后迁移到开源框架：自研的断点恢复与重试是最大的坑。
content: We spent 3 months building a custom orchestrator; resumability and partial-failure handling took another 2 months of hardening. We migrated to an OSS framework and kept only domain-specific routing. 演示摘录：基础设施复用是主要教训。

title: Announcing LangGraph 1.0
snippet: 1.0 承诺 API 稳定，生产案例覆盖多家大厂。
content: LangGraph 1.0 stabilizes the core graph, checkpointing and streaming APIs. Production adopters include Uber, Klarna, LinkedIn, and Elastic. 演示摘录：API 稳定性承诺降低升级风险。

title: Building Effective Agents
snippet: 建议：能用简单编排就不要上框架复杂度。
content: Start with simple, composable patterns; adopt frameworks only when they reduce total complexity. Encapsulate orchestration behind clean interfaces so the framework remains replaceable. 演示摘录：框架可替换性比框架本身更重要。

title: DeepSeek API Pricing
snippet: 每百万 token 输入 $0.27 / 输出 $1.10，缓存命中更低。
content: deepseek-chat: $0.27/M input (cache miss), $0.07/M (cache hit), $1.10/M output. 演示摘录：同级最低价梯队，缓存机制对重复前缀的多 Agent 调用友好。

title: 阿里云百炼模型与价格
snippet: qwen-turbo/plus/max 价格阶梯，新用户有免费额度。
content: qwen-turbo ¥0.3/M input tokens, qwen-plus ¥0.8/M, qwen-max ¥2.4/M; free quota for new users. 演示摘录：按任务分层选档可显著控成本。

title: DeepSeek Service Status History
snippet: 高峰期出现过长时段限流与降级。
content: Several incidents in 2024-2025 with elevated latency and rate limiting during traffic spikes. 演示摘录：生产关键链路需要备用模型或多供应商兜底。

title: 阿里云计算型服务 SLA
snippet: 企业级 SLA 与国内合规认证齐全。
content: Alibaba Cloud provides enterprise SLA up to 99.9% and compliance certifications (等保三级等) for model services on Bailian. 演示摘录：政企与合规场景的默认选项。
